Our story

Two paths, one journey

Autumn 2019

A chance hello

A mutual friend’s terrace, a late monsoon evening, and a conversation about books that refused to end.

Winter 2021

Across the miles

Two cities, countless letters and one standing promise — a sunrise call every Sunday, no matter what.

Spring 2025

The question

Under a canopy of marigolds, with both families watching and a ring hidden in a copy of her favourite novel.

21 February 2027

Forever begins

Surrounded by everyone we love, we will take seven steps together — and we would be honoured if you walked beside us.

“In all the world, there is no heart for me like yours.”
